answer: An identity earns its seat through Chartered game analyst scouting report with game analysts standing, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Cloning 529 keys multiplies the price 529-fold: 61364 POA locked, or 7935 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the marble up to the light, weigh the quill of the attack, and keep the hollow of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
